headline: 2 US soldiers killed in Iranian missile and drone attacks in Jordan
summary: US Central Command confirms deaths and one soldier missing following attacks by Iran and its allies on July 17.
details: Two US service members were killed and one remains missing after Iranian ballistic missiles and drones targeted Jordan. US Central Command (CENTCOM) confirmed the casualties on Saturday.
The incident occurred on July 17 while forces were attempting to intercept the attacks. Four other US soldiers were injured and are receiving treatment at local hospitals in Jordan.
This marks the first US military death since the escalation of tensions between Iran and the US since last March.
Iran's army previously claimed to have targeted US military communication systems and fuel storage tanks at the Azraq airbase in Jordan.
The Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) warned that it would respond more extensively if US aggression continues.
Iran also claimed to have launched cruise missile attacks on a US ship in the Indian Ocean, citing ongoing US-Israeli joint aggression against its territory.
Tehran stated that these attacks persist despite a memorandum of understanding signed between Washington and DC through Pakistani mediation last month.
caption:
Two US soldiers killed and one missing in Jordan. This is the first US military death since the tensions escalated in March.

Two US service members were killed and one remains missing after Iranian ballistic missiles and drones targeted Jordan. US Central Command (CENTCOM) confirmed the casualties on Saturday.

The incident occurred on July 17 while forces were attempting to intercept the attacks. Four other US soldiers were injured and are receiving treatment at local hospitals in Jordan.

This marks the first US military death since the escalation of tensions between Iran and the US since last March.

Iran's army previously claimed to have targeted US military communication systems and fuel storage tanks at the Azraq airbase in Jordan.

The Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) warned that it would respond more extensively if US aggression continues.

Iran also claimed to have launched cruise missile attacks on a US ship in the Indian Ocean, citing ongoing US-Israeli joint aggression against its territory.

Tehran stated that these attacks persist despite a memorandum of understanding signed between Washington and DC through Pakistani mediation last month.

headline_marked: Sanjay Dev and Pritam Hasan to [[perform in Dhaka for World Cup final]]
headline: Sanjay Dev and Pritam Hasan to perform in Dhaka for World Cup final
summary: International DJ Sanjay Dev and singer Pritam Hasan will headline two separate concerts in the capital to celebrate the Argentina-Spain final.
details: Special screenings and concerts have been organized in Dhaka to celebrate the FIFA World Cup final between Argentina and Spain.

International DJ and music director Sanjay Dev, of Bangladeshi origin, will perform at one of the events. He previously gained attention for performing at the World Cup opening ceremony in Canada alongside Bollywood star Nora Fatehi.
Sanjay Dev has already arrived in Dhaka and visited the venue. He expressed excitement about returning to the city where his journey began.
DJ Trisha and DJ Rishad will also perform alongside Sanjay Dev. Following the event, he is scheduled to fly to San Francisco, California, for another concert.
Another event titled 'Final Kickoff' will be held at the United Convention Center in Dhaka.
This event will feature a large-screen screening of the final match accompanied by a concert featuring Pritam Hasan, Firoz Jung, The Brown Testament, and Jessia Islam.
caption:

International DJ and music director Sanjay Dev, of Bangladeshi origin, will perform at one of the events. He previously gained attention for performing at the World Cup opening ceremony in Canada alongside Bollywood star Nora Fatehi.

Sanjay Dev has already arrived in Dhaka and visited the venue. He expressed excitement about returning to the city where his journey began.

DJ Trisha and DJ Rishad will also perform alongside Sanjay Dev. Following the event, he is scheduled to fly to San Francisco, California, for another concert.

Another event titled 'Final Kickoff' will be held at the United Convention Center in Dhaka.

This event will feature a large-screen screening of the final match accompanied by a concert featuring Pritam Hasan, Firoz Jung, The Brown Testament, and Jessia Islam.
